public.title: LRU Cache
public.description: Simulate an initially empty least-recently-used cache. capacity is 1 to 100. Each operation is ["put", key, value] or ["get", key], with integer keys and values between 0 and 10000. put returns null; get returns the stored value or -1 and marks successful access as most recent. Updating an existing key also marks it recent. Evict the least recent key when necessary. Return one output per operation; at most 500 operations.
hints: A Map preserves insertion order; delete and reinsert on access.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The first key is least recent. Refresh key order on successful get and put, and remove the oldest on overflow. O(operations) expected time.
